# Slack / email notify

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P4 · Agents everywhere](../README.md#phase-4--agents-everywhere) · **Lane:** Integrations · **Label:** `feature:user-notify` · **Epic:** — · **Tickets:** 6 (2S 4M)

Warden can send messages to a specific person, not just an alert channel: connect links, grant approval requests, parked-request prompts and expiry warnings, by Slack DM or email. It reuses the internal/integration router for delivery, retries and dead-lettering, and finds the Slack user by the person's email.

## How we build it

- Add an optional capability interface `UserNotifier { NotifyUser(ctx, UserMessage) error }` in internal/integration, discovered by type assertion like `Alerter`. `UserMessage{ID, Kind, Recipient{Sub, Email}, Title, Text, ActionURL, ActionLabel}`; ID is deterministic for idempotent delivery.
- Router gains `DeliverUser(msg)` using its existing per-binding queues, backoff and dead-letter; user messages are not deduped by AlertManager and are bound by `notifications.channels` order instead of alert match clauses.
- New integrations `slack` (internal/integration/slack: bot token, `users.lookupByEmail` with 24h cache and 1h negative cache, `conversations.open` + `chat.postMessage` with a button) and `email` (internal/integration/email: SMTP with STARTTLS, text + HTML).
- New package internal/notify `Service.Send(ctx, kind, sub, data)` in the CP: resolves email from the user directory captured at sign-in, renders embedded templates per kind, tries channels in order with `fallbackToEmail`, dedups per (sub, kind, ref) for 10 min and rate-limits 10 per user per 5 min.
- Messages carry only bounded fields (agent name, provider, scopes, purpose, URL); a check like `assertEgressSafe` rejects anything over size caps.

## Done when

A connect link or grant approval for a user arrives as a Slack DM (or email when Slack lookup fails) with a working action link, with retries and dedup visible in the integrations status.

### 1/6 · W-P4-NTFY-01

**Add UserNotifier capability and router user delivery**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

In internal/integration add `UserMessage`, `UserNotifier` and `Router.DeliverUser`, reusing binding queues, `backoff` and `onDeliveryFailure`. Add `notifications: {channels: [<instance names>], fallbackToEmail: true}` to the integration config; only instances implementing UserNotifier may be listed. Size-bound Title/Text/URL and validate egress safety before enqueue.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] DeliverUser retries with backoff and dead-letters like alerts
- [ ] Listing an instance without UserNotifier fails config validation
- [ ] Oversized text is truncated with the marker

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-NTFY-02`](user-notify.md#26--w-p4-ntfy-02) Add Slack DM integration with email lookup; [`W-P4-NTFY-03`](user-notify.md#36--w-p4-ntfy-03) Add SMTP email integration

### 2/6 · W-P4-NTFY-02

**Add Slack DM integration with email lookup**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Create internal/integration/slack registered as `slack`, implementing `Alerter` (channel post) and `UserNotifier` (DM). Lookup user id via `users.lookupByEmail` with a TTL cache and negative cache; open a DM with `conversations.open` and post Block Kit with one action button. Bot token from env/secret reference, never logged; 429 honors Retry-After.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Unknown email returns a typed ErrRecipientNotFound so fallback can run
- [ ] 429 is retried after Retry-After
- [ ] Tests use an httptest fake Slack API

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-NTFY-01`](user-notify.md#16--w-p4-ntfy-01) Add UserNotifier capability and router user delivery

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-NTFY-04`](user-notify.md#46--w-p4-ntfy-04) Add notify service with templates, dedup and rate limit

### 3/6 · W-P4-NTFY-03

**Add SMTP email integration**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Create internal/integration/email registered as `email`, implementing `UserNotifier` with net/smtp, STARTTLS required by default, PLAIN auth from secret reference, multipart text + HTML. Message-ID derived from UserMessage.ID for idempotency.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Sends multipart mail to a fake SMTP server
- [ ] Refuses to send without STARTTLS unless explicitly allowed
- [ ] Password never appears in logs or errors

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-NTFY-01`](user-notify.md#16--w-p4-ntfy-01) Add UserNotifier capability and router user delivery

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-NTFY-04`](user-notify.md#46--w-p4-ntfy-04) Add notify service with templates, dedup and rate limit

### 4/6 · W-P4-NTFY-04

**Add notify service with templates, dedup and rate limit**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Create internal/notify with `Service.Send(ctx, kind, sub, data)` used by the CP. Kinds: connect_link, grant_approval, park_pending, grant_expiring, grant_blocked; templates embedded via `embed` with text and HTML variants and overridable from `--state-dir/templates`. Resolve the user's email from the directory recorded at portal/console sign-in, try channels in order with email fallback, dedup per (sub, kind, ref) for 10m and rate-limit per user; record each send in admin audit without message text.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Slack-not-found falls back to email
- [ ] Duplicate send within 10 minutes is dropped
- [ ] Unknown sub returns an error and sends nothing

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-NTFY-02`](user-notify.md#26--w-p4-ntfy-02) Add Slack DM integration with email lookup; [`W-P4-NTFY-03`](user-notify.md#36--w-p4-ntfy-03) Add SMTP email integration
